title: 2015 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Wood Goat
seo_title: 2015 Chinese Zodiac: Year of the Wood Goat (19 February – 7 February 2016)
description: 2015 is the Year of the Wood Goat (Yin, Yi-wei), from 19 February 2015 to 7 February 2016. Personality, lucky colors and numbers, best matches, and what to know if you were born in January or February 2015.
lead: Born in 2015? Your Chinese zodiac animal is most likely the Goat, but check the date: the 2015 Wood Goat year began on 19 February 2015. Here is everything about the year, from its element to its lucky colors and best matches.
card_text: 2015: Year of the Wood Goat, from 19 February 2015 to 7 February 2016.

image.caption: Illustration from MyBirthSign's zodiac artwork; it is not a photograph.

paras: The Chinese zodiac year 2015 was the Year of the Goat. It began with Lunar New Year on 19 February 2015 and ended on 7 February 2016, the eve of the next Lunar New Year.

Each year also has an element and a Yin or Yang quality. 2015 ends in 5, which makes it a Wood year, and as an odd year it is Yin. In the traditional stem-and-branch count, 2015 is a Yi-wei year. The same Wood Goat combination comes round only once every 60 years: 1955 before it and 2075 after it.
Lunar New Year 2015 fell on 19 February 2015, so everyone born in January 2015, and in February before that date, belongs to the previous year's animal, the Horse.

The zodiac year starts at Lunar New Year, not on 1 January, which is why early-year birthdays need checking. Our guide Born in January? explains the rule, and the zodiac sign checker gives the exact answer for any birth date.

Our Goat guide describes the sign like this: “Gentle, creative, and compassionate. Goats have a strong artistic sensibility and care deeply for others.” The usual watch-out: “Can be indecisive or overly dependent on others.”

The Wood element adds its own flavour. Wood years bring growth, creativity, and a drive to build new things. People of this element tend to be cooperative, generous, and idealistic. Read more in our Wood element guide, or the full Year of the Goat page.
Careers often linked with the Goat: art, design, counseling, nonprofit work.

sections.h2: Best matches for someone born in 2015
paras: In traditional compatibility, the Goat's best matches are the Rabbit, Horse and Pig, and its clash sign is the Ox, which sits directly opposite it on the zodiac circle. Our compatibility calculator compares two full birth dates, elements included.
2026 (Fire Horse, until 5 February 2027): for the Goat, it is listed as a supportive match of the Horse, so 2026 is traditionally a friendly year.
2027 (Fire Goat, from 6 February 2027): for the Goat, 2027 is a Goat year, so Goat people are in their own year (ben ming nian). See Chinese zodiac 2027 predictions for every sign.

sections.h2: Other Year of the Goat years
paras: Years of the same animal come every twelve years, each with a different element: 1991 (Metal Goat); 2003 (Water Goat); 2027 (Fire Goat); 2039 (Earth Goat). The full list is in our Chinese zodiac years chart.

faq: 2015 is the Year of the Goat, a Yin Wood Goat year (Yi-wei).
When does the 2015 Year of the Goat start and end?
It starts on 19 February 2015 and ends on 7 February 2016.
I was born in January 2015. What is my Chinese zodiac?
A Horse: Lunar New Year 2015 was on 19 February 2015, so all of January 2015 belongs to the Horse year.
Wood. 2015 ends in 5, which belongs to Wood, and it is a Yin year.
Who is the Goat compatible with?
Traditionally the Rabbit, Horse and Pig. The Goat's clash sign is the Ox.
